setEntryProvider(address).notice: Sets the active provider for this vault.

setManagementFee(uint96).notice: Sets the management fee percentage for this vault.

setMinAssets(uint256).notice: Sets the minimum amount required for deposit and mint actions.

setPerformanceFee(uint96).notice: Sets the performance fee percentage for this vault.

setProviders(address[]).notice: Sets the list of providers for this vault.

setTimelock(address).notice: Sets the address of the timelock contract.

setTreasury(address).notice: Sets the treasury address for this vault.

unpause(uint8).notice: Unpauses the specified action in the vault.
